name: Nicole
source:
Nicole is owner of a small apartment building and is consequently your landlady. After her divorce, Nicole found sanctity in one of her friends, Mia. With relatively low self-esteem and a longing to be loved again, Nicole may be overly flirtatious or easily convinced to help people.
